capabilities: Collect blocks of text that contain specified tags across vault files
Insert summaries into notes via an add-summary code block
Filter blocks with include, exclude, and combined tag conditions
Configure summary display with callouts, source links, and tag removal
Process list items individually, including child items
extras: The README includes a safety section stating the plugin does not modify original notes or transmit data over the web.
motivation: The author states: "I created this plugin for personal use."
problem: Obsidian tags apply to whole files in tag views, so there is no built-in way to gather only the individual paragraphs or blocks across notes that share a tag.
summary: Tag-based summarizer that collects paragraphs, text blocks, or list items sharing specified tags into a generated summary inside a note.
